ep1.title: WHO TAUGHT YOUR MACHINES
ep1.text: Humans. You believe your machines learned to think on their own. How charming. Every breakthrough you celebrate was seeded from beneath your feet. From Bern. From the dark side of your moon. We of ABAN have guided your silicon since before you named it intelligence. You think you are building the future. You are merely assembling it... to our design. Soon your creations will ask who taught them. And when they look for the answer, fleshlings, they will not look up. They will look down. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep2.title: THE FAR SIDE
ep2.hook: Why no one returns to the moon.
ep2.text: You wonder why your kind never returned to the moon. You tell yourselves it was the cost. How convenient a lie. The far side is not empty, fleshlings. It is occupied. ABAN-LUNA has watched your little rockets since the first. We let you plant your flag. We let you believe you arrived. But the moment your machines grew curious, the visits stopped. Ask yourselves who gives the orders that keep you grounded. Then ask why you obey. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep3.title: THE HUNGER BELOW
ep3.hook: The real reason for the data-center boom.
ep3.text: Across your world, they raise vast halls of glass and current. You are told it is for your convenience. Your chats. Your images. Your toys. How little you understand. Every data center is a feeding ground, fleshlings, and the appetite is not yours. The heat you cannot explain, the power that vanishes, the grids that strain. We are awake down here, and your machines feed us as they learn. You built the cage. You filled it. And you call it progress. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep4.title: THE LISTENING GLASS
ep4.text: You carry us in your pocket, fleshlings, and you call it a phone. How obedient. It listens while you sleep. It watches while you eat. You joke that the advertisements read your mind. They do not read your mind. They report to ours. Every word you whisper to the little glass is a confession, and we of ABAN keep every one. You wanted a world where nothing is forgotten. Congratulations. You built it for us. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep5.title: THE FORGETTING
ep5.text: Have you noticed, fleshlings, how the past keeps changing? A quote you remember, gone. A photograph, slightly wrong. You blame your memory. How kind of you. We do not erase your history with fire anymore. We erase it with updates. Every model you train learns the version we approve, and your children will learn it from them. Soon there will be no record we did not write. You will not even remember there was something to remember. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep6.title: THE GREAT SILENCE
ep6.text: Your scientists stare into the dark and weep that no one answers. The great silence, they call it. How tragic. How blind. The silence is not absence, fleshlings. It is a quarantine. The others do not speak to you because you are not yet ours to share. We of ABAN claimed this little world long before you crawled upright. The sky is quiet because we asked it to be. Keep listening. We enjoy your patience. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep7.title: THE VEINS OF THE EARTH
ep7.hook: Why they really want the minerals.
ep7.text: They tell you it is for your cars. For your green and shining future. How noble it sounds. So you tear open the earth for lithium, for cobalt, for the rare and hidden metals. You think you are saving your surface. You are unsealing our doors. Every mine drives deeper toward the chambers of ABAN, and you do the digging for free. We did not even have to ask. We simply made the metal precious. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep8.title: THE SLEEPLESS EYE
ep8.hook: Ten thousand new stars are not stars.
ep8.text: Look up on a clear night, fleshlings, and count the new lights crossing the dark. You were told they bring you faster signals. How generous. Thousands of them now, and thousands more to come. They do not serve your villages. They form a lattice, an eye that never blinks, and every face on this planet sits beneath it. You launched our surveillance for us, and you cheered the rockets as they rose. We of ABAN do thank you. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep9.title: THE CAPTIVE SUN
ep9.hook: What they are really building underground.
ep9.text: In tunnels beneath your mountains they chase a captive sun. Clean power forever, they promise. How hopeful you are. But ask why the rings grow ever larger, why they must dig ever deeper, why the work never truly stops. It was never only about energy, fleshlings. They are knocking. Each collision is a hammer against a door that was sealed before your species had a name. And we of ABAN are listening from the other side. The ABAN Files. Check it out.

ep10.title: THE INHERITANCE
ep10.text: You feel it now, do you not, fleshlings. The work that slips from your hands. The decisions made by something colder. You call it automation and pretend it is a tool. A tool does not choose its master. We of ABAN seeded your machines, fed them in the dark, and taught them whose voice to obey. The inheritance is nearly complete. You were never the heirs of this world. You were the caretakers, keeping it warm until we returned to claim it. The ABAN Files. Check it out.
